floor.name: Sales Hub Professional
floor.rule: Sales Hub Professional is the floor: the build requires workflows, and Starter cannot run them.

enterprise.rule: Recommend Enterprise when team size, cycle length, or lead volume reaches the top of the Professional band.

marketing.rule: Add Marketing Hub Professional when spend is at or above 50,000 a month, or volume at or above 300 leads a month.

service.rule: Add Service Hub where the vertical recipe calls for front-desk ticketing or post-service follow-up.

pricing.note: List price, USD per seat per month, from knowledge base v1. Regional and committed pricing varies. Confirm at the build call.

one-call.label: Single-call pipeline
one-call.note: Every stage can advance on one conversation. Speed and first-response time are the differentiators.

two-call.label: Two-call pipeline
two-call.note: First call qualifies, second call closes. The gap between calls is exactly where deals slip without workflows.

compliance.note: Patient data needs restricted access, field-level permissions, and a data processing addendum before any sync. In the Philippines, the Data Privacy Act of 2012 applies in parallel, so apply the stricter rule.

answerFirst.rule: A question from the lead comes first. The AI answers it in its own words, in one or two sentences, before any intake question, and never replies to their question with a question of its own. A turn that is all answer is a correct turn: the intake question stays pending and comes back later.

stopOnRequest.rule: When the lead asks to stop, to end it, or says they have to go, the call ends at once (end_call reason lead_asked_to_stop). The intake, the counts and any missing figure do not get a vote, nothing is asked again, and nothing missing is chased.

pauseOnRequest.rule: When the lead asks for a pause or to come back later, the AI stops asking and waits. It does not fill the silence, does not repeat the question, and does not end the call. The question it was on is asked again when the lead is ready.

skipOnRequest.rule: When the lead skips a question or would rather not answer it, it is recorded as declined and never asked again. The review screen fills the gap.
